points: Mean NDVI of 0.62 indicates a dense, active canopy across the field.
60.5% of analysed pixels fall in the healthy classes and 25.1% in the low classes.
11 weak-vegetation patch(es) were detected (largest 28.12 ha) - good candidates for field scouting.
0.23% of pixels are statistical low outliers relative to the field itself.
interpretation.disclaimer: Vegetation indices measure canopy greenness and density. Low values indicate reduced vigour; they are not a diagnosis of a specific disease, pest or nutrient deficiency. Confirm anomalies with field scouting, tissue sampling or a calibrated model.
